description.narrative: IFC anticipates that the Project will result in improved access to EV batteries for two-wheel (2W) drivers in Kenya and the East Africa region. Across this region, traditional 2Ws are typically used for livelihood generation, and fuel expenses account for a significant share of a drivers daily income. Despite economic advantages offered by electrifying 2Ws (E2Ws), E2W penetration in the region remains limited. The Company addresses adoption barriers by offering drivers a network of battery-swapping stations, which enables them to reduce upfront costs involved in acquiring batteries. The Project is also expected to support the avoidance of GHG emissions, by encouraging the substitution of traditional ICE 2Ws towards 2Ws powered by EV batteries. Beyond the Project, IFC anticipates that the Companys expansion will contribute to improving the competitiveness of the EV ecosystem in Kenya and East Africa by deepening the charging infrastructure component, via enabling framework channels.

IFC is considering an equity investment in Arc Ride Limited (Arc Ride or the Company), an e-mobility startup with its principal operation in Kenya. Launched in 2020, Arc Ride is accelerating Africas e-mobility sector by selling IoT-enabled electric two-wheelers and offering Battery-as-a-Service product, powered by a proprietary tech infrastructure to manage fleet and battery swap facilities.
